## Current-main lane

This is the sole current-main continuation for the Alpha Mermaid graph/parser and diagram-artifact work previously carried as stacked PRs #7 and #8.

Creation baseline:

- Foresight main: `2013351996f1766246f201640795f342b3e12461`
- Katamorph gitlink: `3bd4cf26e68dc88fbe67f831baa4bc389e3363e7`

## Immutable source evidence

- #7 `0cf4136aae9a2e14554dc709141169e7e5be8c09` — Mermaid workflows as lawful graphs
- #8 `5268f6a8de926f4677f2c5ed4243b02026bf2aee` — validated graph projection into Alpha artifacts

#7 conflicts with current main and #8 targets #7 rather than main. Neither source head had a PR-triggered workflow run or review thread.

## Semantics to preserve

- Parse `flowchart` and `graph` headers with LR/RL/TD/TB/BT directions.
- Ignore blank/comment lines.
- Decode box, decision, and round nodes; solid chains; dotted labeled edges; and inline declarations.
- Duplicate identical nodes are idempotent; conflicting node definitions fail deterministically.
- Keep syntax/header/statement failures distinct from graph-law failures.
- Graph shape uses node-map identity and requires every edge endpoint to resolve.
- Parse edges before treating their inline node syntax as standalone nodes.
- Parse every current canonical `.mmd` workflow through bounded filesystem adapters.
- Project only validated graphs into lawful `:diagram` / `:mermaid` Artifacts while preserving original source and graph data unchanged.
- The resulting artifact's extension fields remain inside #51's portability envelope.

## Acceptance / Definition of Done

- [ ] One consolidated PR starts from then-current main and records exact Foresight/Katamorph SHAs plus both immutable source heads.
- [ ] The pure parser, graph laws, and projector share registered CLJC suites executed under JVM Clojure and Node ClojureScript.
- [ ] Negative tests cover bad/missing headers, unknown syntax, conflicting nodes, malformed IDs, and unresolved endpoints.
- [ ] Canonical-workflow discovery is tested separately through JVM and Node filesystem adapters; all checked-in `.mmd` files parse.
- [ ] Artifact projection proves source and validated graph are preserved exactly and validates against current Alpha Artifact laws.
- [ ] Revision-bound JVM and CLJS results at the replacement head are required; ancestor/stack status is not evidence.
- [ ] No Mermaid rendering/browser concern leaks into this pure parse/project lane.
- [ ] Receipt River and Session Mycology record the exact-head evidence and any reader/adapter friction.
- [ ] Source PRs #7 and #8 remain linked as immutable provenance.

## Exit

Close only after the consolidated current-main Mermaid PR is merged with revision-bound JVM+CLJS and canonical-workflow evidence.
